change: Retire remembered travel during an upper-body action when interpolation and movement coasting have stopped. Preserve held aim, channels, rider seating and legitimate cinematic travel.
scope: Client animation state only; no model, animation-clip, server, speed or control changes.
publication: Committed locally alongside the new mounts and coat choices; not merged or deployed.
